Vitality really wants to lose these few events leading upto the major to shed the favourites tag but some teams are not making it easy for them.

Today Faze will eliminate Vitality because if there is one team they'd lose to right now, it is the fan favourite and wounded Faze. This will get two birds with one stone (2nd birs being Karrigan).

Now that they've shed the huge favourites tag to some extent, they will go on to win the IEM Cologne major. It is the script of Budapest major being repeated again.

Thank you for your attention to this matter!
